sourceReasoning.reasoning: initialize_2 assigns distinct negative marks before the TreeSet. computeLinearOrderingMarks removes an item before changing its mark; remaining keys are stable and unique. detectCycles yields unique positive marks before insertion-ordered splitter membership. New split partners are not inserted into the old selected set, and later detection reinitializes marks. Identity membership is valid only under this explicit invariant, not as a generic substitute for mark-based equals/hash.

All critical-split paths, selected-length stable ordering, free-area enumeration, rating alternatives, midpoint fallback, gap consumption and remove/append dependency updates have bounded source anchors. Temporary segments calculate extents on construction; rateArea mutates their coordinate arrays without recomputing extents. Preserve that generated behavior. At most one split per selected initial segment bounds temporary segments by168; proper private ports restrict each initial/split segment to at most two connection coordinates.

Original compare_3 orders -0 before +0. sorted_0 then distinct uses primitive Double ===, which merges the signed zeros and keeps sorted -0. Seven original-helper vectors independently verify this chain, duplicates, tiny coordinates and the Double.MAX_VALUE singleton sentinel. Python comparator sorting followed by numeric-equality linear dedup preserves these operations; no inferred float32 cast or arbitrary unordered set is approved.

KVector equals_9 compares exact finite coordinates and hashCode_69 only chooses lookup buckets. createdJunctionPoints is queried for membership and cleared per boundary, never iterated to choose output order. A value set can therefore preserve membership; junction output order still follows source segment/edge traversal. Use the single A-owned clone/store getter even when the existing JUNCTION_POINTS list is empty.

Keep positive-weight backward reversal, zero-weight backward deletion, retained ties, full retained-link counts, FIFO source order and rightward-target backward pass. Source nextInt can occur inside weighted cycle selection, including bound1. Actual crossing-six executes critical splitting and one31-bit draw, so the old path no-draw reduction cannot be inherited.

WestToEast direction0 dispatch is explicit. Horizontal placement uses full max margins, ratio/default alignment and ordered clamps. Normal tiny-height multiport margins can be nonzero and long-edge dummies have height1 with local port y0; no normal-center/zero-margin prerequisite is approved. Preserve anchor operand order, strict <0.001 dependency versus >0.001 bend tests, split partner handling and actual2/4 bend sequences.
